programme.title: The Travel Show
programme.desc: The Travel Show is a BBC travel programme. The new programme launched in February 2014,[1] and is the immediate successor of long standing travel programme, Fast Track. Utilising a network of correspondents in London, Tokyo, Sydney, New York and Kuala Lumpur, the programme aims to provide unique insight into the world of travel. It first aired in the UK in late February, after Winter Olympics coverage, in a Friday morning slot on BBC Two. A Sunday evening slot was also added on the BBC News channel in April 2014 and BBC iPlayer.

programme.title: The Climate Question
programme.desc: A global programme that reflects the variety of takes on climate change, how best to understand it and the world's attempts to avert it, temper it or adapt to it. It is not about questioning whether climate change is happening, it's about finding the best ways to respond to it. This is sharp-edged, analytical inquiry. Hard scrutiny, touched with a sense of adventure and discovery, and where we can find it, hope. It includes stories from across the world on why we find it so hard to save our own planet, and how we might change that.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies
programme.desc: The series Bubble Guppies revolves around the underwater adventures of a group of mermaid-like preschoolers who life in the fictional underwater city of Bubbletucky. The episode starts with a sketch of Molly saying "Hi, it's me Molly and it's time for-" only to be stopped by Gil doing the subject of the show. When Gil or Molly says "It's time for Bubble Guppies!", the theme song starts. After the theme song, the Little Fish say the episode's name. Something happens when a character goes to school. After that, the school day begins and the Bubble Guppies say "Good morning, Mr. Grouper!". Later, the remaining Guppie tells Mr. Grouper about what happened earlier. He states "Let's think about it," and the characters discuss the topic. The pop song for the episode then begins.One of the Guppies will go to a shop that mostly focuses on the topic. The owner of the shop will asks questions about what he or she needs. Later, Mr. Grouper comes into the shop and says it's time for lunch, and the "Lunchtime" song plays. At lunch the characters make a food joke about the subject of the episode. After lunch, another Gil and Molly sketch is shown. The Guppies do something fun which leads Mr. Grouper talking more about the topic, which leads into a dancing song. Mr. Grouper then says it's time to go outside, the "Outside" song plays, and the Guppies make up a story about the topic. After this, Gil and Molly do another sketch.The Guppies go on a field trip that focuses on the topic, and the show concludes with the last Gil and Molly sketch and a shorter version of the theme song.

programme.title: Breadwinners
programme.desc: Two ducks with thin legs and round faces, SwaySway and Buhdeuce, are best friends. They fly around the water-based planet Pondgea in a rocket-powered van and deliver fresh bread to its citizens. They often find themselves in awkward and funny situations, and sometimes their workdays are quite dangerous. They find new friends, deal with opponents and have fun, making sure Pondgea always receive fresh bread on time.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

Until now, Tori didn't think she had much talent of her own, and was content to live in the shadow of her older sister, Trina. Now, that's all about to change... if Tori can see herself in a new light, even a spotlight! But Hollywood Arts is still a high school, and Tori is still the new kid. She'll have to find new friends, do homework, and just try to fit in. Will Tori grab a starring role in her new life?

programme.title: Sam & Cat
programme.desc: Prepare to meet the strangest match made in bestie heaven -- Sam & Cat! Sam's loud, independent, and tough as nails, while Cat is sweet as pie and super flighty. But that doesn't stop this unlikely pair from becoming best buds and roomies! Together, they're a power duo with a love for fun and adventure -- it's just too bad that it doesn't come cheap. A booming out-of-home babysitting business quickly becomes the answer to their empty-pocket problems, but also an extra reason for countless wacky adventures to come!

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: When Leonardo finds himself the accidental hero in a subway station, saving the lives of innocent bystanders, he's thrilled by the title of HERO. This pushes him to a life of crime-fighting vigilantism, starting with putting the Purple Dragons in their place. But when he's caught on camera and his brothers and April see this Turtle-shaped hero on the news, they interrogate him: what's he up to... and can they get in on it? Now, the four Night Ninjas and April suit up and set out to rid the streets of crime in a single night. Now what's left to do? April finds a dog-napping ring that's been snatching up purebreds. Baiting the dog-nappers with a fancy pooch, the Turtles track the criminals and meet the villainous French florist known as... La Fleur! She and her band of hench-florists are using the dog-napping as a cover-up for a much larger crime. And when the Night Ninjas show up to stop her, it may be too late for Leo and his brothers as the whole thing goes up in flames... literally.

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Leo, Raph, Donnie and Mikey emerge from the sewers to face challenges alongside April O'Neil like never before. When trouble oozes into the streets of New York City, the team finds themselves up against Mechazoids, street gangs, and even the storm of the century! No matter the obstacle, these heroes in a half shell are ready for action with heart and a whole lot of humor.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: When Squidward upsets his local garbagemen, they retaliate by filling his home with trash. Soon, the entire house is overtaken by a vast garbage jungle! With Squidward lost inside, SpongeBob and Patrick go on an adventure to find him. // In his latest secret formula scheme, Plankton disguises himself as a collectible figurine in order to obtain a limited edition Krabby Patty from Bubble Bass' clutches. Instead, he winds up trapped amongst the other collectibles in his basement! Meanwhile, Karen and SpongeBob work together to free Plankton from his packaged prison.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob (unknowingly) gets a magician's magic wand lodged in one of his holes after he and Sandy attend a magic show. Later, SpongeBob gets the hiccups and begins transforming everything (and everyone) around him into ridiculous objects with each hiccup. At the end of the day, Sandy uses her knowledge of science to extract the wand from SpongeBob and return it to the magician. // On Friday the 13th, Mr. Krabs wakes up and swears to avoid all the bad luck that could come his way. Krabs' paranoid superstitious antics quickly disrupt business at the Krusty Krab and the Krusty Krew are forced to address the situation, however, a reverse leprechaun (a Lepre-CAN'T!) materializes. The Lepre-Can't wreaks havoc with its bad luck magic all over the Krusty Krab. SpongeBob, Squidward and Krabs must team up to stop the unlucky creature.

programme.title: The Marsupilamis
programme.desc: Bibi live streams from the Chahuta reviewing the menu. However it doesn't deliver enough likes from her followers, so Twister steps up in disguise to help and is an instant hit. Bibi decides if they reach 1,000 followers she'll unmask him. Jade panics that the Marsupilamis will be exposed, and so Mica with the help of dessert, some flour, and a box does a swift swap with Twister before the grand reveal // A food critic books a table at the Chahuta, which sends Gran Gran into a panic. Mica tries to help Gran Gran make the Chahuta posher, while Jade is convinced that its uniqueness is what makes it special. Mica to stop them interfering locks Jade, Hope, and Punch outside with the Chahuta's regulars while the critic arrives. However, they manage to sneak back in, and switch the critic's meal for the daily special. Surprisingly the critic enjoys the unique atmosphere, the decor and food and awards the Chahuta five stars along with a glowing review.

programme.title: Best and Bester
programme.desc: Best and Bester are a pair of hilariously individual twins who live in a weird and wonderful alternate reality where your neighbour could be a pair of disgruntled trousers or your best friend a floating cloud of bottom burp. But, unlike their friends and neighbours, Best and Bester have the unique ability to choose a new body every single day and, in doing so, experience life in a completely different way.

programme.title: Leek ja monstermasinad
programme.desc: Leek ja monstermasinad on arvutiga animeeritud interaktiivne sari, mille peaosas on Leek, maailma kõige imelisem Monstermasin, tema juht kaheksa-aastane poiss nimega AJ ning nende seiklused Veosilla linnas. Veosilla linnas ei sära ükski täht eredamalt kui Leek. Ta on võidusõidurajal tšempion ning tänavatel kangelane. Kus on pahandust, seal pöördutakse tema poole, sest kõik teavad, et Leek suudab teha asju, mida teised autod ei suuda. Ta on kiireim monstermasin terves linnas: tal on Leegikiirus. Leek suudab seljatada kõik raskused kasutades oma teaduslikke teadmisi. Kui olukord kipub kitsaks, siis suudab ta muunduda ükskõik missuguseks masinaks ning leida lahenduse parasjagu käesolevale probleemile.

programme.title: Käpapatrull
programme.desc: Käpa-Patrull on eelkooliealiste sari, peaosas grupp kangelaslikke kutsikaid: Chase, Marshall, Rocky, Zuma, Rubble ja Skye, keda juhib 10-aastane tehnikataibuga poiss Ryder. Olles unikaalne segu probleemide lahendamise oskustest, ägedatest sõidukitest ja armsast rohkest kutsahuumorist, teeb Käpa-Patrull koostööd ülitähtsatel päästeoperatsioonidel, et kaitsta Seiklustelahe kogukonda. Tuletõrjekoer Marshallist politseikoer Chase'ini, ja Skye'ni, kes lendab kõrgelt oma helikopteriga, näitavad nad tiimitöö ja hea kodakondsuse tähtsust. Neil kõigil on seljas omaenda eriline Kutsakott, mis aitab neil kõigega toime tulla - kassipoegade aitamisest rongi päästmiseni kalju äärelt! Ja pole vahet kui suur on seiklus, Käpa-Patrullil on alati aega mänguks, naeruks ja üheks kõrvasügamiseks Ryderilt. Lõbus Käpa-Patrulli fakt: Ryder päästis kõik need kutsad ja õpetas neile nende Käpa-Patrulli oskused.

programme.desc: Inimomadustega loomade maailmas on Sam Lumi ja Kit Casey Clade'i (Loomadetektiividest ekspertide salajase liiga) eliitagendid, kes reisivad maailmas ringi, lahendades müsteeriume oma probleemilahendamise ja loomafaktide oskustega.

programme.title: Hirvemeeskond
programme.desc: Meie kapjadega kangelased on tagasi ja seekord läheb Hirvemeeskond siit maailmast minema! Valmistu kangelaslikeks planeedijõu päästmisteks suurema jõu, lahedate uue tegelaste, imeliste vidinate ja esimest korda, erakordsete kosmose seiklustega!

programme.title: Põrsas Peppa
programme.desc: Peppa on armas ja alati rõõmsameelne põrsaplika, kes elab koos oma väikese venna George'i, Emme Põssa ja Issi Põssaga. Peppale meeldib mängida, end põnevalt riidesse panna, väljas käia ja mudalompides hüpata. Ta seiklused lõpevad alati õnnelikult ja suure naeruga.

programme.title: Põrsas Peppa
programme.desc: Peppa mängugrupp peab aiamüügi, et uue katuse jaoks raha koguda. Madame Gasell palub kõigil midagi müüa. Peppa ja ta sõbrad toovad vana mänguasja, aga varsti mõistavad, et sellest on raske lahti lasta.

Tuletõrjekoer Marshallist politseikoer Chase'ini, ja Skye'ni, kes lendab kõrgelt oma helikopteriga, näitavad nad tiimitöö ja hea kodakondsuse tähtsust. programme.desc: Meeskond ehitab Lucasele ja Lilyle limonaadileti, aga hapu Kiirusmeister saadab selle Ehituslahe linnale veerema! Miks kobras Crunchy teed ületab? Sest Rubble ja meeskond ehitab silla, et ta teisele poole saaks.

programme.title: Hr Krokodill
programme.desc: Daisy muretseb, et tema ja Winston on igavesti üksteise küljes kinni, kui nad jäävad Winstoni hüppenööri külge sõlme. Daisy ja hr Krokodill proovivad aidata Rolandil leida parimat sõpra, kellega tammetõru üritusele minna.

programme.title: Leek ja monstermasinad
programme.desc: Leek ja monstermasinad on arvutiga animeeritud interaktiivne sari, mille peaosas on Leek, maailma kõige imelisem Monstermasin, tema juht kaheksa-aastane poiss nimega AJ ning nende seiklused Veosilla linnas. Veosilla linnas ei sära ükski täht eredamalt kui Leek. Ta on võidusõidurajal tšempion ning tänavatel kangelane. Kus on pahandust, seal pöördutakse tema poole, sest kõik teavad, et Leek suudab teha asju, mida teised autod ei suuda. Ta on kiireim monstermasin terves linnas: tal on Leegikiirus. Leek suudab seljatada kõik raskused kasutades oma teaduslikke teadmisi. Kui olukord kipub kitsaks, siis suudab ta muunduda ükskõik missuguseks masinaks ning leida lahenduse parasjagu käesolevale probleemile.

Rubble ja tema pere - tädi, vanaisa, nõod ja teised - aitavad ehitada Ehitajatepesa linnast tõeliselt toreda elupaiga. Esimeses osas ootab neid ees suur ülesanne: sillaehitus! Kui kavala Kiirusemeistri plaanid hakkavad seda takistama, peavad kutsikad tegutsema ühiselt ja leidma nutika viisi, kuidas päästa päev ja ehitada turvaline sild.

programme.title: Rubble ja meeskond
programme.desc: Mis oleks toredam kui üks kutsu ehitusmasinas? Palju kutsusid ehitusmasinates. Rubble ja tema pere - tädi, vanaisa, nõod ja teised - teevad kõvasti tööd, et nende kodulinn, Ehitajatepesa, oleks üks igati v-auhh-va koht, kus elada.

programme.title: Barbapapa - Üks suur perekond

programme.title: Barbapapa - Üks suur perekond

programme.title: Barbapapa - Üks suur perekond
programme.desc: Barbabravol, Barbalalal ja Barbabeaul on kõrini vendadest ja õdedest, kes nende üle naeravad.

programme.desc: Rubble ja meeskond ehitab Ehituslahte esimese rongijaama, et tervitada farmer Zoe uut lehma Mooreeni. Popstaar Sierra Säde kolib Ehituslahte! Aga kui kutsad plaanivad üllatustervitust, võtab Kiirusmeister plaani üle.

programme.title: Rubble ja meeskond
programme.desc: Kui jänkupere hüppab jalgpalliväljakule, siis Rubble ja meeskond kasutab oma oskuseid, et luua uus spordiala... Jänkupall. Kutsad avastavad uut liiki liblika, aga see lendab minema. Kas suur liblikaaed aitab teda tagasi tuua?

programme.title: Barbapapa - Üks suur perekond
programme.desc: Barbabeau unustab raamatu raamatukokku tagastada. Raamatukoguhoidja hr Strict külastab Barabapapat ja Barbabeau otsutab põgeneda. Barbamamma tahab, et lapsed magamistube koristaksid. Nad peidavad end, et mitte koristada.

programme.title: Европа в фокусе
programme.desc: Актуальные события стран Европы.

programme.title: Верните мне имя
programme.desc: Даже самая страшная правда лучше, чем неизвестность. Так говорят те, кто долго не знал, что с самыми дорогими для них людьми. Этот фильм о том, как возвращают тела погибших украинских воинов. Свидетельство о масштабе горя, которое причинила и продолжает сеять Россия. Честный рассказ о солдатах этой войны со статусом "пропавший без вести". Не о записи в документах, не о статистике и не только о факте гибели. Это о большой работе тех, кто идентифицирует и устанавливает nимена. О тысячах семей, которые ищут своих близких всеми возможными nспособами, и, в конце концов, о жертве, которую им пришлось принести. Это фильм о пути домой воинов, чьи имена едва не украла война. Он nначинается на поле боя, на которое солдаты вступают, защищая свой народ и свою землю, и заканчивается, когда их тела нашли и вернули родным. Фильм раскрывает смысл понятия "пропавший без вести" через конкретные истории людей, страдающих от неизвестности, в частности, историю женщины, которая за год стала женой, мамой и вдовой.

programme.title: В поисках Ситоры: Спасти дочь от ИГИЛ
programme.desc: Мать пропавшей Ситоры Фозиловой проживает в Германии. Здесь, далеко от Таджикистана, ей не дает покоя лишь один вопрос: где ее дочь и внуки. Пять лет назад их след простыл в Сирии, куда они отправилась вместе с мужем, примкнувшем к запрещенной в Таджикистане группировке "Исламское государство".

programme.title: Реальная история
programme.desc: Масштабный просветительский проект направлен на деконструкцию исторических мифов, опровержение многолетних манипуляций и возвращение истинного понимания прошлого. В центре внимания — ключевые этапы создания государства, фигуры выдающихся лидеров и малоизвестные факты, которые десятилетиями замалчивались или искажались. Благодаря привлечению ведущих ученых, работе с уникальными архивными документами и динамической визуальной подаче проект превращает сложные исторические процессы в понятный и увлекательный контент. Это интеллектуальное путешествие, которое помогает осознать продолжительность борьбы за независимость и найти подлинные смыслы национальной идентичности в контексте современности.

programme.title: Балтийский путь
programme.desc: Это фильмы о людях, живущих в Латвии, Литве и Эстонии. Они говорят на разных языках, но все — об одном и том же: о том, что волнует, огорчает или радует каждого из нас. Мы не делим жизнь на политику и всё остальное — мы просто говорим о самом важном.

programme.title: Главные фигуры
programme.desc: Президент Владимир Путин так давно находится у власти, что многие просто не замечают никого рядом. А ведь именно свита играет короля. Окружение Путина несёт не меньшую ответственность за политический режим внутри страны и многолетнюю военную агрессию. Кто же они, откуда взялись и какие интересы преследуют? О людях вокруг Путина в совместном проекте Настоящего Времени и The Insider.

programme.title: Искусство в деталях
programme.desc: Передача "Искусство в деталях" глубоко исследует международную креативную сцену, раскрывая новые идеи и объясняя культурные феномены, которые формируют нашу историю, настоящее и будущее. Кто такие современные художники? Какие произведения стали их визитной карточкой? Какое влияние они оказывают на общество? И где можно познакомиться с их яркими проектами?

programme.title: Ждём в гости
programme.desc: Кто только не жил в старом Тбилиси, люди разных национальностей и разных культур. Не зря грузинская столица воплотила в себе характерные черты восточной и европейской культур одновременно. Целая плеяда народных сказителей, поэтов, уличных музыкантов породила неповторимый жанр городского фольклора Тбилиси. Особо почитались они у мастеровых или карачохели. Местные ашуги слагали баллады о любви, настоящей дружбе и храбрости. Причем пели они как правило на нескольких языках: грузинском, армянском, турецком и фарси. В программе рассказывается и о тех музыкальных инструментах, которые были популярны в то время. А также зрители увидят, как сегодня выглядят уличные концерты в типичном тбилисском дворике

programme.title: Перекрёсток
programme.desc: Сериал, состоящий из короткометражных документальных фильмов, посвященных сложным темам в странах Восточной Европы и Ближнего Востока. Это aвторский взгляд на проблемы и перспективы этих регионов. Настоящая жизнь крупным планом.

programme.title: Настоящее Время. Интервью
programme.desc: Все о чем вы уже вкратце слышали в новостях, но хотели бы узнать подробности. Настоящее Время задает злободневные вопросы ключевым игрокам важных событий, беседует с известными политиками, узнает мнение компетентных аналитиков

programme.title: Европа в фокусе
programme.desc: Актуальные события стран Европы.

programme.title: Реальная история
programme.desc: Масштабный просветительский проект направлен на деконструкцию исторических мифов, опровержение многолетних манипуляций и возвращение истинного понимания прошлого. В центре внимания — ключевые этапы создания государства, фигуры выдающихся лидеров и малоизвестные факты, которые десятилетиями замалчивались или искажались. Благодаря привлечению ведущих ученых, работе с уникальными архивными документами и динамической визуальной подаче проект превращает сложные исторические процессы в понятный и увлекательный контент. Это интеллектуальное путешествие, которое помогает осознать продолжительность борьбы за независимость и найти подлинные смыслы национальной идентичности в контексте современности.

programme.title: Балтийский путь
programme.desc: Это фильмы о людях, живущих в Латвии, Литве и Эстонии. Они говорят на разных языках, но все — об одном и том же: о том, что волнует, огорчает или радует каждого из нас. Мы не делим жизнь на политику и всё остальное — мы просто говорим о самом важном.

programme.title: Главные фигуры
programme.desc: Президент Владимир Путин так давно находится у власти, что многие просто не замечают никого рядом. А ведь именно свита играет короля. Окружение Путина несёт не меньшую ответственность за политический режим внутри страны и многолетнюю военную агрессию. Кто же они, откуда взялись и какие интересы преследуют? О людях вокруг Путина в совместном проекте Настоящего Времени и The Insider.

programme.title: Искусство в деталях
programme.desc: Передача "Искусство в деталях" глубоко исследует международную креативную сцену, раскрывая новые идеи и объясняя культурные феномены, которые формируют нашу историю, настоящее и будущее. Кто такие современные художники? Какие произведения стали их визитной карточкой? Какое влияние они оказывают на общество? И где можно познакомиться с их яркими проектами?

programme.title: Репортер
programme.desc: Необычные истории из повседневной жизни

programme.title: Будущее сегодня
programme.desc: Как изменится мир в ближайшие десятилетия? Какие открытия больше всего повлияют на нашу жизнь? Документальный научно-популярный сериал RTД "Будущее сегодня" - это рассказ о новых технологиях, которые должны сделать существование человека более комфортным, здоровым и долгим. Ведущие проекта попробуют заглянуть в будущее и представить, что нас ждёт.

programme.title: Грани времени
programme.desc: Еженедельная итоговая программа с Мумином Шакировым.

programme.title: Верните мне имя
programme.desc: Даже самая страшная правда лучше, чем неизвестность. Так говорят те, кто долго не знал, что с самыми дорогими для них людьми. Этот фильм о том, как возвращают тела погибших украинских воинов. Свидетельство о масштабе горя, которое причинила и продолжает сеять Россия. Честный рассказ о солдатах этой войны со статусом "пропавший без вести". Не о записи в документах, не о статистике и не только о факте гибели. Это о большой работе тех, кто идентифицирует и устанавливает nимена. О тысячах семей, которые ищут своих близких всеми возможными nспособами, и, в конце концов, о жертве, которую им пришлось принести. Это фильм о пути домой воинов, чьи имена едва не украла война. Он nначинается на поле боя, на которое солдаты вступают, защищая свой народ и свою землю, и заканчивается, когда их тела нашли и вернули родным. Фильм раскрывает смысл понятия "пропавший без вести" через конкретные истории людей, страдающих от неизвестности, в частности, историю женщины, которая за год стала женой, мамой и вдовой.

programme.title: В поисках Ситоры: Спасти дочь от ИГИЛ
programme.desc: Мать пропавшей Ситоры Фозиловой проживает в Германии. Здесь, далеко от Таджикистана, ей не дает покоя лишь один вопрос: где ее дочь и внуки. Пять лет назад их след простыл в Сирии, куда они отправилась вместе с мужем, примкнувшем к запрещенной в Таджикистане группировке "Исламское государство".

programme.title: Человек имеет право
programme.desc: В программе Марьяны Торочешниковой юристы, правозащитники, гражданские активисты и обычные граждане подводят главные итоги недели.

programme.title: Признаки жизни
programme.desc: Документальное кино о реальной российской жизни от протестов у Кремля до очереди за хлебом в провинциальном городке. Мы рассказываем истории людей: обитателей больших городов и заброшенных деревень, успешных и не очень, переживающих горе и радость. Кино о людях разных судеб и убеждений, которых объединяет то, что они живут в России.

programme.title: Америка. Большое путешествие
programme.desc: Документальный проект рассказывает о разных американских штатах и городах через истории их жителей, культуру и кухню. Авторы приглашают зрителей за кулисы известных туристских центров и знакомят их с людьми, которые представляют собой коллективный портрет американского общества и демонстрируют лучшие качества американского характера: целеустремленность, инициативность, самодостаточность. Особое внимание в каждом эпизоде будет уделяться предпринимателям, сильным и независимым женщинам, успешным эмигрантам и представителям меньшинств.

programme.title: Нью-Йорк New York
programme.desc: Нью-Йорк, New York - воскресный видеожурнал о городе большого яблока и его обитателях. Что надо увидеть, узнать, съесть, надеть и... понять о Нью-Йорке. Ведущие Елена Мещерякова и Евгений Маслов покажут вам места, ставшие символами города, и объяснят, почему они до сих пор сохраняют свою важность. Мы прогуляемся по Центральному парку и Таймс-сквер, зайдем на Центральный вокзал и поднимемся на Эмпайр-стейт-билдинг. Вы познакомитесь с личными историями ньюйоркцев, которым есть что рассказать. А еще вам будет интересно узнать о странных нью-йоркских привычках, будь то плавание в ледяной воде или игра на бочках.

programme.title: Свидетели Путина
programme.desc: События фильма начинаются 31 декабря 1999 года, когда россиянам представили их нового президента. Фильм основан на уникальных и строго документальных свидетельствах истинных причин и последствий операции "преемник", в результате которой россия оказалась с президентом, который правит страной до сих пор. Главными героями фильма являются Михаил Горбачев, Борис Ельцин, Владимир Путин и русский народ, который как всегда безмолвствует.

programme.desc: Tune in and follow all the matches from the ACB League, also known as the Endesa League for sponsorship reasons, the top-tier men's basketball league in Spain.

programme.title: Borders
programme.desc: Adjara, Emma, and Sali meet in a bus. All three are heading for Lagos on the Bamako-Ouagadougou-Cotonou bus route. Broken down cars, road blockers, theft between passengers, this journey is to become a real nightmare. But the toughest challenge is crossing the borders.

programme.title: The Face of Love
programme.desc: Several years after the death of her husband, a widow meets a stranger who greatly resembles her late husband, from his striking blue eyes to his kindness and humor, and falls in love with him, and, again, meets the love of her life.

programme.title: Mozart and the Whale
programme.desc: A love story between two savants with Asperger's syndrome, a kind of autism whose effects sabotage their budding relationship.

programme.title: That's What I Am
programme.desc: A coming-of-age story set in 1965 that follows 12-year-old Andy Nichol (Chase Ellison), a bright student who, like most kids his age, will do anything to avoid conflict for fear of suffering overwhelming ridicule and punishment from his junior high school peers. Everyone's favorite teacher, Mr. Simon (Ed Harris), pairs Andy with the school's biggest outcast and social pariah, Stanley, aka "Big G" (Alexander Walters), on a critical term project. Sporting thick orange hair, a head too big for his body and ears too big for his head, "Big G" has been the object of ridicule since grade school. Before long, Andy will learn that there was truly a method behind Mr. Simon's madness as to why he teamed these two up. As the story unfolds, Mr. Simon finds himself the target of a malicious rumor after Principal Kelner (Amy Madigan) suspends a school bully for brutally beating up a female classmate whom he thinks has "cooties."

programme.title: The Magic of Belle Isle
programme.desc: Monte Wildhorn (Freeman) is a famous Western (genre) novelist. His struggle to cope with the death of his wife six years earlier has sapped his passion for writing and has caused him to begin drinking heavily. He takes a lakeside cabin for the summer in picturesque Belle Isle and befriends the family next door—an attractive single mother (Madsen) and her young daughters—who help him find inspiration again.

programme.title: Louise Violet
programme.desc: France. End of the 19th century. Louise Violet, a Parisian teacher, is sent on a mission to the French countryside. She has to impose the free, compulsory and secular school of the Republic.

programme.title: The Fabulous Patars
programme.desc: After the death of his beloved spouse, Denis, a loving father, is struggling with the education of his two daughters, Jenine and Mercredi, and his two jobs. When he forgets to pick Mercredi up from school, the director calls the social services. Severine, a social investigator, forces Denis to attend parenting classes, under penalty of withdrawing the custody of his daughters…

programme.title: Allelujah
programme.desc: The Beth, a small community NHS geriatric facility in Yorkshire, is facing closure because of Whitehall budget cuts. Colin, a management consultant for the health department, arrives to visit his ailing ex-miner father and to make an appraisal. Meanwhile, the staff and patients are preparing a presentation for the formidable Nurse Gilpin, who is to be presented with a long service medal. Based on the successful stage play by Alan Bennett.

programme.title: The Graduate
programme.desc: Classic Oscar-winning comedy drama. Disillusioned graduate Benjamin Braddock is urged by his family to enter a business career and settle down after college, but instead he finds himself seduced by Mrs Robinson, a friend of his parents. He tries to extricate himself from the affair when he falls in love with Mrs Robinson's daughter, but finds that his own actions may have sealed his fate. Featuring the music of Simon and Garfunkel.

programme.title: Waking Ned
programme.desc: The lucky winner of the national lottery is Ned Devine, so taken by his good fortune that he now can't be waked, because he died from the shock of it! News of the win spread quickly in the scenic little Irish village of Tully More, but not the secret news of Ned's demise. With lottery officials closing in to confirm the prize claimed by the deceased Devine, Ned's closest friends scheme to keep the prize money close to home, in memory of Ned of course! But as the plot twists humorously, they learn it is hard is to keep such a secret in a small town.

programme.title: Beauty And the Beast
programme.desc: A widowed merchant moves to the countryside with his six children after going bankrupt. His youngest daughter, Belle, is the only one happy with the change. When the merchant's lost ship is found, he plans to reclaim his assets. On the way, he encounters the Beast's magical domain, where his needs are met. However, he is caught picking a rose and must return to the castle or his family will be killed. Feeling responsible, Belle offers herself in her father's place.

programme.title: Barley Fields on the Other Side of the Mountain
programme.desc: In the remote mountains of Tibet, a teenage girl must choose between supporting her family after her father's political imprisonment or joining a group of oppressed nuns on their journey to freedom.

programme.title: Recalled
programme.desc: A woman begins having disturbing visions after losing her memory; as she pieces together the disjointed fragments, she comes face to face with a shocking truth about her husband.

programme.title: Mr. Morgan's Last Love
programme.desc: Michael Caine and Clémence Poésy star in writer-director Sandra Nettlebeck's romantic comedy-drama. Retired philosophy professor Matthew Morgan (Caine) is a non-French-speaking American living in Paris. Recently widowed, he's attempting to come to terms with the loss of his much-loved wife (Jane Alexander), with whom he has fantasy chats. One day, he meets lonely young dance teacher Pauline (Poesy) on a bus, where she helps him out of an awkward situation. It's the start of a relaxed but close friendship that rekindles his dormant interest in life. She teaches him the cha-cha and he talks to her about the great thinkers of philosophy. But his sadness about his bereavement overwhelms him and he attempts to kill himself. Morgan's estranged children, Miles (Justin Kirk) and Karen (Gillian Anderson), turn up from America. They're both worried and angry about their father and his new friendship, not least because they believe Pauline might be a gold-digger. Network premiere.

programme.title: Gainsbourg: A Heroic Life
programme.desc: Lucien Ginsburg, a rebellious French Jewish boy with a grotesque imagination, hates playing the piano like his father, a bar professional, and manages to be admitted to Montmartre Academy as a painter, where he befriends an SS officer who helps him survive the occupation. After the war, he chooses to become a performing artist and adopts the stage name Serge Gainsbourg. His unorthodox songs bring him success, even his parents's approval, and lots of lovers, yet his marriages are all utter failures.

programme.title: Sharks of the Shadowland
programme.desc: Attack survivor Jenny Oliver and researcher Kina Scollay are on a quest to find out if the mysterious Sevengill sharks are targeting divers - and whether they are hunting in packs.

programme.title: Animal Cribs
programme.desc: American animal TV series with designer Antonio Ballatore own show creating the perfect space for pet owning families. Believing that if dad can have a "man cave" and mum a "she shed" then surely there is such thing as a animal crib?! Antonio's passion for design and animals shines through throughout every episode. Joined by project manager Grace and their trusty companion Chewie the Bulldog they produce the most fantastic spaces for both pets and their owners. Pets include Chinchillas, dogs, cats and snakes and possibly many more.

programme.title: Lone Star Law
programme.desc: Reality series, set in Texas and similar to ''North Woods Law'', that follows daily lives of men and women who are Game Wardens and whose job is to protect deserts, lakes, woods, bayous, coasts and wild animals that live in the second-largest state in the U.S. These people have their plates full as they must deal with poachers, hunters who don't obey the law, smugglers, while they rescue injured wildlife and defend citizens.

programme.title: Alaskan Bush People
programme.desc: Alaskan Bush People is an American docudrama-style reality TV series revolving around the Brown family, members of which are trying to survive in the wilderness, far away from the society. Take a journey deep into Alaska's bush, where naturalist and adventurer Billy Brown, along with his wife, Ami, and their seven children, choose to live life on their own terms, connected to wild nature and bonded to each other.

programme.title: How Do Animals Do That?
programme.desc: How Do Animals Do That is a documentary series where experts answer various questions about the animal kingdom, revealing some amazing fun facts along the way. Animals have super powers humans can only dream of, they can do incredible things. The series provides answers to the questions how they do it and why. Find out why moths are attracted to flames, why turtles cry, why sea otters bond with stones, and why dogs wag their tails.

programme.title: Animal Cops: Philadelphia
programme.desc: Animal Cops: Philadelphia follows the work of the Pennsylvania SPCA's Humane Law Enforcement team as they investigate cases of animal cruelty; rescue sick and abused animals and fight for justice on their behalf. The Pennsylvania SPCA's humane law enforcement officers cover an area of over 46,000 square miles from their headquarters in Philadelphia. The six offic ers with full police powers and six agent trainees are on call 24 hours a day seven days a week protecting the city's one and a half million pets.

programme.title: Wild Mexico
programme.desc: Mexico is an ancient land, full of diversity and mystery. It is home to a vast wilderness of oceans, deserts, jungle, and unique creatures that are found nowhere else on earth.

programme.title: Little Giants
programme.desc: When one thinks of dominant animals that roam the earth, large predators - lions, grizzlies and titanic anacondas come to mind. But, pound for pound, the most powerful and awe-inspiring creatures are the elusive micro-monsters that exist just beneath our feet. Wildlife author & expert Bradley Trevor Greive and biodesigner Billy Almon venture to some of the most remote and inhospitable habitats in the world to track down these tiny beasts. Using state of the art equipment, they will measure the abilities of these creatures and present them in a way never seen before.

Dr. Jeff's sharp surgical skills and his unconditional love for animals make him one of the most respected vets in the country. Dr. Jeff has a dedicated team of more than 30 veterinary staffers and once a month they go to remote locations where people do not have access to vets.

programme.title: The Aquarium
programme.desc: Reality-documentary series following the lives of the aquatic inhabitants at the Georgia Aquarium. The largest in the United States and fourth-largest in the world, the aquarium boasts a wide range of diverse inhabitants and explores the relationship between animals and trainers. The 10-million-gallon (38-million-litre) facility plays home to over 500 marine species including endangered penguins, rescued sea otters and recovering sea lions. The show reveals the difficulties that come with nursing and caring for such a wide variety of species. With many heart-warming scenes, the series beautifully reveals the friendships between the different species and how they learn to co-exist with each other.

programme.title: Pit Bulls & Parolees
programme.desc: Pit bulls are eager to please, faithful and enthusiastic friends and pleasant with children according to credible canine organizations. But they have fallen from grace. Now often associated with gang members, dog fighting and attacks. That's about to change. Animal Planet introduces you to this dog's greatest ally, and she's not a man - she's a fiery red-headed leading lady, and she's determined to end the needless hostility toward pit bulls. Meet Tia Maria Torres - 49-year-old mother, top pit bull trainer and founder and owner of Villalobos Rescue Center - the country's largest rescue facility for pit bulls.

programme.title: My Cat from Hell
programme.desc: Jackson Galaxy is a cat behaviorist. He is the person who resolves conflicts or behavioral issues between the owners and their cats or even between the cats and other pets. These are attacks and misbehavior, and Jackson is a true cat-lover and a believer that any problem can be solved thanks to love, patience and proper handling. Taking good care of cats is a demanding process and a whole science, but in return you will get a loving and purring family member.

programme.title: The Pool Master
programme.desc: The Pool Master is a show presented by Anthony Archer-Wills, a top pool expert, landscape architect and artist. Team of professionals lead by him design and build amazing one-of-a-kind pools, which are in great demand among homeowners. After seeing masterpiece by Anthony, you will never agree to have a rectangle with water for swimming. Multipurpose pools for exercising and entertainment full of flowers, waterfalls, decorated with natural stone according to every taste and wallet will take your breath away.

programme.title: Extinct or Alive
programme.desc: Extinct or Alive is an Animal Planet documentary show exploring the possible existence of animals thought to be extinct. Biologist and explorer Forrest Galante follows real life stories and visits wildlife locations across the planet, hoping to discover proof that animals such as the Zanzibar leopard or the Galapagos tortoise still exist. Find out if his methods will bring new exciting discoveries. Could animals we think are extinct for a century still be found in nature?

programme.title: Tanked
programme.desc: Follow aquarium enthusiasts Brett Raymer and Wayde King as they attempt to build some of the most luxurious fish tanks in the world. At Acrylic Tank Manufacturing, the brothers-in-law guide you through the design process and the building of their truly jaw-dropping aquariums. Experience the unveiling of finished tanks housed everywhere from restaurants and banks, to glamorous casinos and mansions. Join the duo in their Las Vegas workshop as they deliver some budget-shattering builds to their high-profile clientele.

programme.title: The Last Alaskans
programme.desc: The Last Alaskans chronicles the daily rituals of four families choosing to live in seclusion, vast distances from each other as they overcome harsh arctic conditions, frustrating setbacks, and aggressive wildlife while they survive in one of the last great unspoiled and unforgiving wildernesses on the planet. In the refuge, prop planes, canoes and dog sleds replace the modern luxuries that most people take for granted. Humans cohabit with the animal world and often share the same emotions and struggles while they discover that they are not necessary at the top of the food chain. Utilizing an authentic and organic approach to document the weeks leading up to and during the winter season, The Last Alaskans sets a distinctive and vibrant tone unlike any other docu-series before to completely immerse the viewer into a world that would otherwise be lost in history.

programme.title: The Zoo
programme.desc: A behind-the-scenes look at the Bronx Zoo, one of the largest zoos in the USA and the largest city zoo the country has to offer. Opening their doors to camera crews, the daily operations of the world-famous animal sanctuary are revealed, as the staff keep their loving creatures healthy and happy. Renowned for its diverse collection of animals and wonderful exhibitions, the Bronx Zoo is one of the finest in the world, home to lions, bears, tigers, snow leopards, baboons, flamingos and many more extravagant species. This series showcases the effort, experience and expertise required to run the Bronx Zoo.

programme.title: Homestead Rescue
programme.desc: This reality TV show follows Marty Raney and his two children, Matt Raney and Misty Bilodeau, who are successful homesteaders from the state of Alaska and have the skills needed to fish, hunt, raise livestock, and otherwise survive in an untamed landscape. Struggling homesteaders across the country call these experts to help them save their homesteads and become self-sufficient while they teach them the necessary skills to survive the wilderness.

programme.title: Dogs: The Untold Story
programme.desc: Dogs: The Untold Story is an amazing documentary series providing us with unbelievable stories, research results and facts about our best friends, healers and protectors- dogs. They have evolved from predators to favourite pets, adored by millions people all over the world. They can understand people and even talk to them, they have been by human's side for more than 33.000 years. Dogs are actually more incredible than anyone has ever imagined.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods
programme.desc: Travel and cuisine documentary series, hosted by famous Andrew Zimmern, American culinary expert, chef, restaurateur and television personality and spin-off series of ''Bizarre Foods'', focuses on classic, iconic foods (not bizarre like in the original series) from some well-known destinations- moussaka and real Greek yogurt from Athens, sweet macarons and crepes from Paris, Italian gelato, gooey fondue to Swiss chocolate from Zurich, mile-high pastrami sandwiches and bagels from NYC, and many other legendary foods. The show will explore where these dishes came from, how they're prepared, and the best way to enjoy them. Andrew will also discover some secrets and interesting stories behind these epic meals.

At the beginning of each round they receive a basket containing four mystery ingredients and are expected to create the best three-course meal using every single one of them. Each round has a time limit. The dishes are judged based on their presentation, taste and creativity. At the end of every round one chef is "chopped" from the competition with no prize. The winner can get up to $50.000.

The host is American restaurateur Guy Fieri who travels along the USA, Canada or Europe looking for the most fascinating cafes and introduces them to the viewers. Each show has a specific focus on a certain dish, like burgers, pasta, comfort food. Small cafes with traditional food and home-style recipes or ethnic specialties adored by the locals are of particular interest to the host. Guy Fieri enters the kitchen, gets to know the cook, actively takes part in cooking, interacts with the guests and kitchen staff and gives his humorous spicy comments on the process and the food itself.

The winners walk out with $10,000 cash, a prized knife from the losing chef's knife roll and bragging rights for life!

programme.title: Man v Food
programme.desc: Every region has its own local culture and flavor. One of the best ways for a traveler to immerse him or herself in new destinations is to taste these unique dishes. This taste exploration allows even the strictest of dieters the freedom to indulge. In the new series, Travel Channel's Man v. Food, host Adam Richman sets out to travel the country in search of the best places to do some serious indulging. Starting season 5, Casey Webb took over as host.

programme.title: Cake Boss
programme.desc: Carlo's Bakery in Hoboken New Jersey create elaborate, elegant and interesting edible art cakes. Cake Boss follows the team, led by Buddy Valastro, as they design and create two of these masterpieces for all kinds of events and occassions. The show explores the intricacy of working with your family, and their interpersonal relationships with other employees. Watch as they create everything from classic wedding cakes to alien spaceships.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Take one sassy former city girl, her hunky rancher husband and a band of adorable kids, an extended family, cowboys, 3000 wild mustangs, a herd of cattle and one placid basset hound and you have The Pioneer Woman. The Pioneer Woman is an open invitation into Ree Drummond's life: The award-winning blogger and best-selling cookbook author comes to Food Network and shares her special brand of home cooking, from throw-together suppers to elegant celebrations. The series, set against the incredible story of life at home on the range, is the next best thing to actually sitting on a stool in Ree's kitchen.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: After combating countless "impossible dinners," Chef Robert Irvine faces a daunting new challenge: save America's most desperate restaurants from impending failure in just two days with only $10,000. In his new prime-time Food Network series, Restaurant: Impossible, Robert uses creativity and resourcefulness along with a lot of muscle in his fight to rescue these restaurants and give hope to the owners and their employees. Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

programme.title: The Holzer Files
programme.desc: Based on the real life files of America's first ghost hunter, Dr. Hans Holzer (whose most famous case concerned the Lutz family of Amityville, NY), this show follows a team of paranormal investigators as they reexamine the terrifying tales that mystified the doctor. The team consists of paranormal investigator Dave Schrader, psychic medium Cindy Kaza and equipment technician Shane Pittman and they are aided by Holzer's daughter, Alexandra. They examine thousands of documents, letters, photographs, and audio and visual recordings, sometimes going as far back as the 50s. Following on from where Holzer left off, the team bring the investigations up to the present day and visit the locations of the supernatural events such as the Peck House, the Morris-Jumel Mansion, the Whaley House, and the USS Constellation.

Comprised of Louisiana local Jereme Leonard, psychic medium Sarah Lemos, former FBI agent Ben Hansen, and local historian Diane Wiltz, the team delves into the truth behind the ghostly events. Reality-documentary series.

The six-part series follows eight men who leave behind their families, friends and homeland to strike it rich against all odds while struggling to survive against the harshest of conditions. Greenland's a veritable beast, but the motley crew of ICE COLD GOLD miners is up for the challenge. Each thinks he has what it takes to walk away with gold, rubies and sapphires before winter and large mining companies swoop in. What transpires as the miners cope with the unpredictable, harsh unknown? Are they humbled by their journey? Do their personalities get in the way? Most importantly, do they strike ICE COLD GOLD?ed ice sheets.

programme.title: Ice Cold Gold
programme.desc: The gold of Eqi might be Sixty Degree Resources final hope. The seven miners are about to reach their tipping point. Even though Saqqaq was a success, Cloud Island was a huge failure and their faith in Eric's strategy is losing steam. But even after suffering one catastrophic blow after another, they find themselves very confident when it comes to their next base camp, Eqi. They found huge quantities of gold there last season, and the team is positive the target will produce even more. However, once they reach Eqi and set up basecamp, the team's geologist, Eric Drummond, reveals his new secret plan. Will his vision divide the team more or bring them together at last?

programme.title: Finding Bigfoot
programme.desc: From small towns in the South to remote areas of the Pacific Northwest and Alaska, four eccentric but passionate members of the Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization (BFRO) embark on one single-minded mission: to find the elusive "creature" known as Bigfoot or the Sasquatch. The team consists of Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization (BFRO) founder and President Matt Moneymaker, researchers James "Bobo" Fay and Cliff Barackman and skeptical scientist Ranae Holland. The series never questions the existence of Bigfoot, but rather documents the team's search efforts and study of evidence in an attempt to prove the existence of the elusive creature.

programme.desc: Follow a team of highly specialized paranormal experts, who help both the living and the dead and focus on a distinct type of haunting - ''ghost loop'', which happens when paranormal entities terrorize the living through endless and repetitive supernatural cycles, manifesting again and again in the same location. In each episode, paranormal investigator and medium Sean Austin, empath Kris Star, researcher and tech advisor Chris Califf, design specialist Eric Vitale, and tech support Matt Lytle, examine and research their client's property and history. Then, they formulate a plan they believe will help stop the haunting - whether it's building a 1900s-era train compartment, replicating a tavern from the 1850s, or constructing a 19th century baby's nursery. The team uses emotionally charged settings to draw out the entities in hopes that it will release the energy and break the loop once and for all.

Together they interview witnesses and gather evidence, uncovering the fact behind the fiction to decipher what or who is causing the hauntings. These paranormal places are scattered across America and have long claimed to have spooky pasts; the team hope they can solve the mysteries once and for all. Reality series.

programme.title: Murder In the Heartland
programme.desc: January 20, 1992, Twinsburg, Ohio: Charlene Puffenbarger, age 26, was found beaten, strangled and suffocated. Her son, Dustin Redmond, age 3, was the only witness to her brutal murder. As investigators continue to follow every tip that comes in, an unexpected source leads them to the killer. One suspect they look at is Willard McCarley, but the case goes cold for decades. Charlene's mother, Phyllis, does all she can to keep the case alive. Finally, in 2017, thanks to advances in DNA matching, Willard McCarley is convicted of Charlene's murder. He is sentenced to life in prison with the possibility of parole in 2037.

programme.title: Murder In the Heartland
programme.desc: This series focuses on the dark underbelly of the American mid-west, its heartland. Each episode deals with a specific murder that's been commited in one of the small towns that make up this iconic region of the US with the locals enhancing the tales and bringing clues to our attention. The show includes interviews with the victim's family, friends, law enforcement officers and also provides dramatic reenactments to bring the stories to life. Episodes reveal true stories such as when an Oklahoma family's dog drops a human skull onto their porch and the police are called in to investigate; a bride-to-be who discovers her betrothed shot in the head in their living room; a beloved father, son and fiancee who is discovered beaten to death in his own driveway; and a devoted family man who diappears after his truck is set on fire.

programme.title: Evil Lives Here: Shadows Of Death

Evil Lives Here: Shadows of Death explores the endless reach of evil, a reach that extends long after the act of evil itself. This original series highlights the struggle to survive as innocent people find themselves caught in the wake of death and evil.

Interlaced within every episode are exclusive interviews with People's journalists, archival footage, re-creations, and firsthand accounts by those closest to the investigations.

programme.title: Wheeler Dealers

The budget is limited, though you can see some exclusive and rare cars. Mike Brewer, a British dealer chooses the car carefully and hands it over to the mechanic, first Edd China, later Ant Anstead to be fixed and upgraded. The hosts are real masters of their trade, it seems they can bring life even to a piece of metal. It does not matter if you are a life-long car enthusiast or do not even have a driving license you will admire the results of hard work from the beginning to the end of the long uneasy restoring process.

programme.title: River Of No Return
programme.desc: This reality series follows a small, tight-knit community of people who live in Idaho's remote Frank Church Wilderness, characterized by rugged mountains, deep canyons and roaring rivers, and rely on themselves, the help of their neighbors and a set of survival skills that help them to endure challenging and isolating winters. The residents of "The Frank" tackle everyday life in one of America's last frontiers where they face the many tests Mother Nature throws in their direction, navigate the ordinary domestic challenges of home and family-life and forge unbreakable bonds with those who share their unique lifestyle. This show spotlights how these homesteaders - from twenty-somethings seeking to test their limits, to the living legends who have chosen to spend their lives in Idaho's ''River of No Return'', live on their own terms.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters
programme.desc: Drew Pritchard is a modern-day treasure hunter searching the back roads of the UK to discover hidden riches. With demanding customers, high turnover and one of the biggest decorative salvage yards in the UK, Drew is constantly on the road, crisscrossing the country in search of derelict gems and forgotten remnants. Drew loves the thrill of the hunt and while he gets his hands dirty in the country's architectural backwaters, his crack team of restorers is back at the shop giving old and rare finds a new lease on life. Follow Drew and his crack team of specialists on a fascinating journey through the entire picking process – from the initial expedition, to renewal, and finally to resale. Showcasing his hard-earned knowledge and appreciation of salvage and restoration, each episode accompanies Drew on one big buying venture, such as setting off with an empty van and returning with a 20th century stained glass Gothic doorway from an Irish monastery – as well as the small, unpredictable adventures along the way. Simply discovering a treasure is only half the battle, as Drew must artfully convince owners to sell, and at his price. After a successful purchase, Drew and his team of experts bring the items back to Fabulously British Salvage, his tremendous 20,000 square foot showroom located in North Wales, to restore them to their original brilliance, before reselling them for profit. This is not an easy business, as any trip can feature the next great find or a bust that costs Drew and his team thousands. However, Drew's keen eye and adroit negotiating skills are second to none – his passion and drive for success make him one of the best in the business.

programme.desc: Gold Rush is a reality television series that follows the placer gold mining efforts of various family-run mining companies in boundless north of America. The series focuses on the work process in the conditions of permafrost and working relations between the participants. The show has 10 seasons altogether. Then there appears several gold mining teams that compete with each other. In some episodes the teams move to South America. Admire the courage and determination of the team members in their unstoppable desire to become rich.

programme.title: 90 Day: The Single Life
programme.desc: Follow a group of people from the series ''90 Day Fiancé'', whose international relationships fell apart, as they embark on a new adventure, and start going on dates in an attempt to find love - again. Some of audience's favourites - Big Ed, Colt, Danielle, Molly, and others, are searching for someone new, and you can join them on their journey.

programme.title: 90 Day Diaries
programme.desc: An intimate look into the lives of our couples told from their perspective. Without producers or crew, the cast films their day-to-day lives as they continue to navigate the COVID-19 pandemic and all of the challenges it brings to their relationships.

programme.title: Love & Translation
programme.desc: The series brings three American men and 12 international women together on a remote paradise island for a chance at finding romance. And here's the twist: none of the women speak English and none of the men speak other languages. Without being able to speak to one another and without the use of translators, the singles need to count on their senses to help develop their connection and determine the power of their chemistry and attraction.

programme.title: Polyfamily
programme.desc: Alysia's attempt to reconnect with her unsupportive father has the quad voicing concerns about his behaviour. Sean crosses a boundary with Alysia.

programme.title: Welcome To Plathville
programme.desc: Welcome To Plathville is an American reality series following husband and wife Kim and Barry Plath, and their nine children; Ethan, Hosanna, Micah, Moriah, Lydia, Isaac, Amber, Cassia, and Mercy. Apart from Ethan and Hosanna, who live with their respective spouses, the family reside on a rural farm in Georgia, where the children must abide by Kim and Barry's conservative rules. No sugar, no television, no non-religious music and no video games, the children must follow their parents' strict guidelines, as family life centres around music and God. We follow the family through their daily routines, revealing all the drama that ensues with having so many children.

programme.title: Kitchen Boss
programme.desc: Hosted by Buddy Valastro, this cooking program takes various Italian-American dishes from Valastro's own family recipes and shows how they can be prepared in minimal time and using ingredients that are easily obtainable and affordable. Each meal usually consists of a main course, a side dish and a dessert and Buddy is joined in the kitchen by members of his family to show us how it's done and to add authenticity. Episodes feature Buddy and his wife Lisa making chicken Sorrentino with fusilli with a side of asparagus and chocolate dipped strawberries for dessert for date night; Auntie Anna revealing her secret recipes for manicotti and her chicken with vinegar peppers; or Buddy and his cousin Frankie reminiscing about the sights and food of Italian street fairs. The recipe for each dish can be found on the show's website.

programme.title: Say Yes To the Dress: Lancashire
programme.desc: It's the dress that all little girls dream of, and one that most will only get chance to pick out once. A fairy tale occasion that has the ability to make dreams come true. It's also the source of tantrums, tears and arguments all wrapped up in tulle and satin with an intricate beading. A bride's journey to picking out that perfect wedding gown is a near military operation. Luckily, Gok Wan has joined the expert bridal consultants at Ava Rose Hamilton's Boutique in Lancashire to help an abundance of brides-to-be track down their dream dress. But, with budgets to consider, personal issues, dramas and the opinions of the entourage, will Gok be able to help these brides find their perfect gown?

programme.title: 90 Day Fiance
programme.desc: Buckle up, TLC and 90 Day Fiancé fans! Hot off their upcoming appearance on 90 DAY FIANCÉ: HAPPILY EVER AFTER?, fan-favorites Pedro and Chantel and their lively in-laws will be the focal point of a spinoff series from the 90 DAY FIANCÉ franchise called THE FAMILY CHANTEL, premiering Monday nights this July. Ever since Chantel first introduced Pedro to her family under the false pretense of him coming to America on a student visa, the drama that followed has kept fans obsessed. From their beginnings on 90 DAY FIANCÉ season four through 90 DAY FIANCÉ: HAPPILY EVER AFTER, Pedro and Chantel have weathered major marital ups and downs involving everything from feisty family members to their own trust issues. Viewers will follow this unique modern family as they try to move past their differences and come together as an extended family, but as Chantel's parents Karen and Thomas try to protect their brood, will they push their children too far? The family members featured in the upcoming series include Chantel's parents Karen and Thomas and siblings River and Winter, as well as Pedro's mother Lidia and sister Nicole.

programme.title: Brides, Grooms And Emergency Rooms
programme.desc: American reality series from TLC. Your wedding day is something you always dream of, it's meant to be the biggest, brightest and most beautiful day of your life, but for these unlucky couples there's only one possible way to describe it. Absolute Hell! Instead of heading off together into the sunset, on their luxurious romantic honeymoons to exotic locations, these poor Bride and Groom's are on their way to the Emergency Room. What a nightmare! From being held for random in Mexico, to your whole wedding guest list being taken down by a dreadful sickness bug, it will definately be a day to remember!

programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper
programme.desc: Definitely not created for the squeamish, Dr Pimple Popper features dermatologist and Internet celebrity Dr. Sandra Lee as she treats patients suffering with unique skin conditions such as facial and skin disorders. Those included within her videos gave written permission for her to record and post the content in exchange for discounted or free-treatments. Dr. Pimple Popper is on a mission to reclaim the lives of those suffering with these unusual and rare skin condition and remove their embarrassment.

programme.title: Take My Tumor
programme.desc: Features three doctors removing tumors from patients with extreme cases. Experts in their field and renowned surgeons, Dr. Kimberly Moore Dalal, Dr. Jason Cohen, and Dr. Ryan F. Osborne take on some of the most challenging cases of their careers. Patients from all over the world, are looking to get their lives back and these surgeons are their last hope. This intense series highlights unique patients, difficult surgeries, and life-changing procedures.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: Even during a pandemic, smuggling never stops. After adjusting tactics in the early days of the COVID crisis to meet the increasing flow of narcotics coming across our southern land borders, the Department of Homeland Security is now pivoting back to our nation's airports where international travel is starting to rev back up again. Whether narco-traffickers try to slip through an airport, seaport or land crossing, vigilant officers are on high-alert to stem the flow of illegal contraband. Using every tool available to them, DHS will stop at nothing to catch a smuggler.

programme.title: Seconds from Disaster
programme.desc: In the golden age of ocean liners, one ship has been built to outpace and outshine them all: the Titanic. Billed as the "Unsinkable" ship, the Titanic is a mechanical marvel, a combination of innovative and luxurious design. However, just days after its voyage begins, the Titanic meets a catastrophic end, becoming one of the biggest shipping disasters of all time. On 14 April, 1912 at 11:40 PM, the Titanic grazes an iceberg, which causes the ship to sink, taking with it the lives of more than 1,500 people. Officials have struggled for decades to sift through the theories and conspiracy speculations to figure out what sank the massive ship. Using a groundbreaking experiment that mimics the conditions of the Titanic as it scraped the iceberg, experts find new evidence that enables them to finally conclude what brought the "unsinkable" ship down in the middle of the icy Atlantic. Titanic includes haunting commentary of eye-witness accounts, CGI and cutting-edge experiments that help bring the Titanic back to life to retrace its final moments.

programme.title: Built for Mars: The Perseverance Rover
programme.desc: NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory to follow the birth of the Perseverance rover, whose primary mission is to search for traces of life in an ancient river delta on Mars and collect samples for eventual return to Earth.

programme.title: Inside Airport: Lost & Found
programme.desc: Airport employees reunite travelers with their lost items, including a pair of ornate Shriners fezzes, a bride's pearl necklace, and a $12,000 Jaeger watch. In New Orleans, a mom retrieves the wallet she left on the plane after buying snacks for her kids, and in Alabama shoppers from around the country line up for hours to enter Unclaimed Baggage's giant annual sale of lost ski equipment.

programme.title: Inside Airport: Lost & Found
programme.desc: Airport workers undertake true detective work to trace the owner of a duffel bag brimming with old family photos. A woman searches for Christmas decorations that are part of a family gifting tradition. In Tampa, the lost and found department donates items to a local women's shelter, including a $700 purse. In New Orleans, a young man loses his wallet upon arriving for a college tour.

programme.title: Drain the Oceans
programme.desc: When Mt. Vesuvius erupted 2000 years ago, it buried the towns of Pompeii and Herculaneum. Today new discoveries are revealing a detailed timeline of the final heart-breaking moments of the citizens trapped in its aftermath. Archaeologists are finding that many of those who didn't survive belong to a previously hidden world of enslaved peoples, a forgotten class of ordinary people vital to ancient Roman society.

programme.title: Drain the Oceans
programme.desc: The Amber Room is one of the world's most valuable lost art treasures. Stolen by the Nazis and kept in a castle on the Baltic coast, it vanished in the brutal last months of the war. Today the new discovery of a shipwreck holding a large secret cargo leads explorers to the heart of the mystery, and reveals a forgotten tragedy of 1945: the largest sea evacuation in history, dwarfing Dunkirk in size.

programme.title: Pole to Pole with Will Smith
programme.desc: Joined by linguist Dr. Mary Walworth and local marine ecologist John Aini, Will travels to the South Pacific on an expedition to a remote island threatened by rising seas. What begins as an exploration into an incredible marine paradise quickly transforms into a truly revelatory journey for Will about his own history as they record a lost language spoken by only five people.

programme.title: Pole to Pole with Will Smith
programme.desc: Will travels deep into the Kalahari Desert to meet the San people, one of the oldest hunter-gatherer groups on Earth. To discover the secret to their enduring success, he must join them on a hunt in one of the most inhospitable places on the planet. Led by local San bushman guide Kane Motswana, it's not long before he realizes he's entirely unsuited to this adventure.

programme.title: Inside the CIA: Secrets and Spies
programme.desc: The no-fear gene: In a country where the punishment for espionage is death, a young CIA officer — and the real-life inspiration for Carrie Matheson from "Homeland" — is kidnapped at gunpoint during a routine intel exchange. Isolated and under threat, she must rely on her training and instincts to survive a tense 24-hour standoff that could end in catastrophe.

programme.title: Inside the CIA: Secrets and Spies
programme.desc: A double life within a double life: A former CIA chief of base utilizes her knowledge of covert exfiltration and the connections she made while working as one of America's top spies to help rescue vulnerable people during the chaos following the 2021 U.S. withdrawal from Afghanistan. Tapping into years of covert experience, she stepped out of retirement and into action to try and save as many lives as she could.

programme.title: No Man Left Behind
programme.desc: January 1991, The Gulf War. Eight SAS commandos are dropped off 140 miles behind enemy lines in Iraq. Their mission is to spy on a main supply route carrying Saddam Hussein's mobile SCUD missile launchers across the Iraq desert. But the mission goes disastrously wrong. Only one would escape the enemy and make it out of Iraq alive…

programme.title: No Man Left Behind
programme.desc: October 1993. Keni Thomas and Randy Ramaglia are among a squad of US Rangers and Delta Force who rope down from Black Hawk helicopters into the capital of war-ravaged Somalia. Their mission: to capture two top lieutenants of rebel leader Mohamed Aidid. But the daring raid goes disastrously wrong when Black Hawk Super 6-1 is shot down over the city. The ground troops are sent to secure the crash sites but they are outgunned and overrun, sustaining multiple casualties. When Super 6-4 pilot Mike Durant flies in to help, his Black hawk is shot down too. His crew dead, he is captured and held for 11 days. The infamous Battle of Mogadishu sees 18 Americans dead and 73 injured.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. Unraveling the complex mystery is a painstaking process that takes months—and sometimes years—of detective work. The twisted wreckage at the crash site tells part of the story; investigators can use it to learn about the final seconds of a flight and rule out mechanical failures. The flight data and cockpit voice recorders are critical, but they don't always reveal what happened. It almost always takes a tragic combination of factors to bring down an airplane.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. This season on Air Crash Investigation: Conflicting stories emerge after a Swedish cargo plane spirals to the ground; an African airliner crashes in the wilderness and the cause proves too sinister to be believed; and, when a Pakistani passenger jet disappears on approach to Kathmandu, Nepalese investigators must determine how it ended up on a crash course with the Himalayas.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: April 4, 1977. Southern Airways flight 242 is en-route from Huntsville, Alabama to Atlanta, Georgia. Ten minutes into the flight the crew notices a menacing storm in their path. Their radar shows them a "hole" in the middle of the storm, the crew believes that "hole" is an area of better weather, and decides to fly towards it. Suddenly the plane is in the midst of a punishing rain and hailstorm. The hail is so severe that it cracks the cockpit windshield, and visibility is nonexistent. They crew has lost power to many of their instruments, and one by one theyve lost both of their engines. Theyre now trying to glide to a safe landing. The tower suggests heading towards Dobbins Air Force Base, 20 miles away. En route to Dobbins the crew realizes they arent going to make it, they decide to put the DC-9 down on a nearby highway. Almost immediately though, it clips a tree with its left wing, ploughs into a car at service station, breaks up and bursts into flames. An inferno erupts. The flight crew, 62 passengers, and 8 people on the ground are killed. Astoundingly, 21 people on board survive.

programme.title: Incas: The Rise and Fall
programme.desc: At its height in the early 16th century, the temples and palaces of Cuzco overflowed with fine goods and precious metals. The wealth of the Incas even helped inspire the legend of El Dorado. Meet the most powerful Inca emperor: Huayna Capac, known for his violent and ruthless rule. Over his 30-year reign, Huayna Capac spent long periods campaigning in the north of his empire, conquering new lands and suppressing rebellions. With an iron grip, he maintained control, enforced mandatory labor, exported agricultural technologies, relocated hundreds of thousands of people across the Andes, and centralized South America's production in Cuzco.

programme.title: Incas: The Rise and Fall
programme.desc: From the arrival of Francisco Pizarro in South America to the fall of the Inca Empire, less than 10 years passed. But how could such a powerful empire commanding over 30,000 soldiers collapse so quickly to just 200 Spanish conquistadors? The tragic fate of the last three Inca sovereigns, three brothers, each played a decisive role in the brutal downfall. The conquistadors were better equipped, master tacticians, and aided by rebellious Indigenous peoples. Some Incas resisted, but within a few decades, the Spanish wiped out the legacy of the Sons of the Sun. Thanks to the latest scientific advances and ultra-realistic 3D reconstructions—from Cuzco to the Chilean desert, via Cajamarca, and the Pacific coast—this is the brutal fall of the Empire of the Sun.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of the Maya
programme.desc: National Geographic Explorer Albert Lin ventures into the Guatemalan jungle to explore how a new high-tech treasure map is revealing tens of thousands of ancient ruins. Now, dozens of archaeologists are heading on a voyage of discovery, exploring lost ruins for the first time in 1500 years. And what they're finding is rewriting the history of one of the world's most mysterious ancient civilisations - the Maya.

programme.title: Jäähoki MM
programme.desc: Jäähoki 2026. aasta maailmameister selgub 15. kuni 31. maini Šveitsis toimuval turniiril. Teekonda ihaldatud tiitli poole alustavad 16 meeskonda, kes on jaotatud kahte alagruppi. Zürichis mängivasse A alagruppi kuuluvad valitsev maailmameister USA, Šveits, Soome, Saksamaa, Läti, Austria, Ungari ja Suurbritannia. B alagruppi kuuluvad Kanada, Rootsi, Tšehhi, Taani, Slovakkia, Norra, Sloveenia ja Itaalia. See alagrupp mängib Fribourgis. Alagrupiturniir toimub 15. kuni 26. maini. Mõlemast alagrupist 4 paremat pääsevad rehamängudele kaheksa parema hulka. Veerandfinaalid mängitakse 28. mail. Poolfinaalid mängitakse 30. mail. 3.-4. koha mäng ja finaal mängitakse pühapäeval, 31. mail.

programme.title: Korvpall: EuroLeague. 1/2 final. Olympiacos - Fenerbahce
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.
